newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Lion quietly confident after Deng's death.
newsitem.headline: Lion quietly confident after Deng's death.

text.p: Brewer Lion Nathan Ltd, which has substantial investments in China, is quietly confident it will be "business as usual" after the death of paramount leader, Deng Xiaoping, spokesman Graham Seatter said on Thursday.
"We've got a degree of confidence that we are far enough down the track that the political environment should not threaten us too much," Seatter told Reuters.
"So I guess we are quietly confident and a little bit unsure, but only time will tell," he said.

"We've always felt reasonably confident that we have progressed to the extent that the political environment would not be too threatening to us, but we obviously accept that nothing is certain in this world," he said.
Lion Nathan has substantial interests in the Yangtse Delta region, including an existing brewery at Wuxi and one under construction at Souzhou.
Seatter said the NZ$200 million Souzhou plant was on track to go into production in time for the Chinese summer, and probably before its scheduled start-up of April.
